verdict.rationale: Agents can be exercised away from production in two documented ways. A built-in test framework runs behavioral tests in pytest/Vitest, and agent simulations hold end-to-end conversations against an LLM-driven user. A hands-on probe also showed `livekit-server --dev` booting locally with placeholder keys and no account, which gives an isolated environment separate from any production deployment. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that tests or simulations are isolated from production data or tools (e.g. mocking of tool calls or external APIs), a documented hosted sandbox or staging project on LiveKit Cloud, and independent corroboration of the test framework in use.
